lead.headline: Tuten sat out Wednesday and the 9-0 team fixed its lineup — it is 49% now
lead.deck: Add Zvada before Thursday, take Gordon at FLEX, and check Tuten at 10:30 Sunday.
lead.body: The bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten missed Wednesday's practice with his ankle and foot and is now questionable; Jacobs is out after finger surgery; Loveland is on bye; Wilson and Pickens sit questionable on the bench. Maye-day, 9-0, swapped their bye-week players out this afternoon, and ESPN's 58% this morning is 49% now. Two free moves remain from this morning and neither is made: add Dominic Zvada for Matt Gay before the Giants kick off Thursday at 19:15, and start Gordon over Marks at FLEX by Sunday noon. If Tuten is inactive at 10:30 Sunday, Marks takes his slot. Mahomes practised fully, which is Rice's week. Nothing on the wire is worth priority that never resets.
